notes.title: News on Sentry Games and Sunset Free Update!
notes.content:
News on Sentry Games and Cellyon Boss Confrontation’s Sunset Free Update!

Hello, everyone!

It’s been a couple of years since Cellyon has launched and we wanted to take a moment to reach out and give an update from Sentry Games!

First and foremost, thank you everyone for your playtime and feedback. Particularly a warm thank you to all our backers. This development journey made us progress and mature as a studio! It’s been so exciting to self publish (with its ups and downs). It was a product of our love. After almost 4 years since the early access release and 2 since official release, we are hard at work on our next projects. But it doesn’t mean that we are going to forget about Cellyon...

We have one last big Sunset Update coming this week as a thank you, which is what we’re here to talk about today.

Since Early access, we’ve updated the game with multiple rounds of bug fixes, perf improvements, and quality of life features. The cadence of these updates has gone down recently. Why’s that? Well, we’re turning our attention to the future of Sentry Games' other exciting projects.

The SUNSET UPDATE is a quality of life update to give you a cleaner playtime and potentially more content to unlock.

[list]
[*] Game Start beautification rework. A bit more dynamic for sure!
[*] Texture optimization to improve performances. Every fps counts!
[*] Free access to all players battle pass allowing to unlock Tanner and coppersmith armors.
[*] Dead-End of Simulacrums Solo Boss improvement of phase 3 Invocation.
[*] In-game user interface default size decreased by 10%. Don’t hesitate to customize your game interface if you need bigger icons and text in-game!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/d9c082bb43d74edea19439a2c0f1ca3ea26204e3.jpg[/img]

We've also separated the Cellyon Boss Maker as a Free DLC to lighten new player integration to the game. 😉

It’s up to you to keep playing Cellyon, create bosses, share it with your friends and who knows, other updates might arise. 

Don’t hesitate to join the [url=https://discord.gg/ErnVfzM]Discord[/url] to find a group of players and set up boss raid times! LINK 
Have fun!

Sentry Games Team

notes.title: Cellyon: Boss Confrontation Official launch
notes.content:
After two years in early access, Cellyon: Boss Confrontation is available in its final version!

With this new version, you can discover additional content, brand new features, and a ton of bug fixes.

[h2][b]A whole new combat menu[/b][/h2]

The combat menu changes completely! Expect for the custom mode, which you can still use to play the levels from the workshop, the other game modes have been replaced, and you can now find these features between two new game modes:

[b]- The expedition mode[/b]

Through the expedition mode, you can randomly generate a list to boss to fight, with the difficulty setting you want. If you go for mythic difficulty or more, you can even opt to add affixes that completely change the fight and force you to improvise a new strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/2379c34f1e48b58f463ff139642034a6267f17b5.png[/img]

Once the expedition is created, don't forget to share it with the other members in your group so you can all enjoy the rewards, then go and win every successive level!

If you're victorious, a final reward awaits you with bonus loot rate for legendary items.
[b]
- The quick play mode[/b]

In the quick play mode, you're in control of everything! You can select any boss fight, and adjust its difficulty or affixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/62d48478daac84022604680c65bac05fd4690ca7.png[/img]

Even better, you can see the ranking of all the players on every boss, according to the highest reached difficulty. Will you get the first place for your favorite boss ?

[h2][b]A new class: the Steam Crusader[/b][/h2]

Other novelty, you can now play with the Steam Crusader!

This cast was initially formed to use hematomancy in blacksmithing, but when the invasion began they were quick to turn the fire and steam toward their enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/d313a504be02a6842bede99712f1f6e994dc4e42.jpg[/img]

With a gameplay that changes radically from the Blood Bender, you will have to use your skills with caution to manage a specific new resource : The heat

Use fire spells to increase it and deal more damage, but be careful not to reach the critical amount or you'll overheat.

On the opposite, use steam spells to hide yourself in the mist and cool down your equipment, while staying above the cristallisation limit.

[h2][b]Solo challenges[/b][/h2]

Finally, in addition to the prologue, you can play on new solo bosses, with difficulty levels and affixes! 
With them come new maps and effects to use in the boss editor!

But most importantly, some of these bosses are creations from the community! Huge thanks to both Saanen and Chaos, feel free to congratulate them on the discord and to download their other bosses on the workshop.

We hope that you'll enjoy this update and if you have any suggestions or wishes regarding the game, let us know on the community hub or directly on Discord: https://discord.gg/sentrygames

notes.title: Update v0.9.8: The Litany of the Willows
notes.content:
[h1]Adventurers, [/h1]

Welcome to patch 0.9.8 which will offer you a whole new challenge! Will you be able to face it and overcome it?

[h1]The Litany of the Willows[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/89d64d045a13ef76c87a5df7d8f7463fc1d42895.png[/img]

The oldest devout of Cellyon makes its entrance intto the game. In the heart of a temple buried under the forest bordering the Red Lake lie Humbaba and its Willows. They challenge anyone who dares prevent them from quenching their thirst for revenge.

Will you dare to venture this far into Hildra in an attempt to stop them from harming humanity and destroying everything in the name of their departed god?

Throughout the event, you can earn portraits, tags and resources to customize your avatar.

The fight against Humbaba will be available through the event window before joining Hunt mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/629c54fc86b3a0aa245937e8f1183d2fc08933aa.png[/img]

In addition, you will find the following fixes and improvements:

[u]Changes: [/u]

- Button names are now in TitleCase

[u]Corrections: [/u]

- Fixed a bug that prevented the display of normal rewards after completing an event pass
- Fixed a bug where the player would receive messages regarding the bots they were playing with
- Disabled zoom button when you are in UI Editor
- Tooltips are now correctly displayed in the Hunt menu

[u]New: [/u]

- Halloween decorum has been removed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/4f93ce29eb23791cf6106ff95cf4b8782a415b37.png[/img]

[u]Cellyon: Boss Maker:[/u]

- Added a projectile node that causes any vfx model to appear as a projectile from one of a character's hands or neck. The projectile then flies towards its target at the specified speed. The following effects are only performed after the projectile has hit its target.
- A projectile node can also be associated with a cast node so that the projectile appears during the animation and is launched at the right time.
- Fixed over-exposure in the preview window.
- Fixed a bug where summons would appear shifted from the position specified in the editor

We hope that you'll enjoy this update and if you have any suggestions or wishes regarding the game, let us know on the community hub or directly on Discord: https://discord.gg/sentrygames

notes.title: Update v0.9.7: Graphical update
notes.content:
[h1]Adventurers, [/h1]

Welcome to patch 0.9.7. After 3 months of work, we are delighted to present you with a graphic upgrade of the game.

This patch is also an opportunity for us to move from Unity 2019 to Unity 2020 and then benefit from all the latest features and optimizations that this new version provides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/7af9076c95312a82182d500dc5b19d69ac82f1ce.png [/img]

In addition, you will find the following fixes and improvements:

[u]Optimizations: [/u]

- Improved bot behavior.
- Improved performance of lightning bolts and rifts (Dumuzid fight).

[u]Changes: [/u]

- Help menu modernization and revision.
- Increased the default size of Dumuzid.
- Revision of screens containing previews (characters / equipment / bots).
- Notifications of new spells / outfits / puzzle pieces etc. are hidden on mouse over.
- Revision of the custom game system (see Steam workshop at the end of the patch note).
- The Restore Preset button (in the Spellbook) restores only the selected preset and no longer all the presets.
- The "Hard" difficulty from the Mission mode has been removed, but you'll still be able to find the associated mechanics in the Hunt mode.
- The talent levels have been removed and the global player level is now used to unlock the new spells. Experience points and rewards for the completion quests have been ajusted accordingly.

[u]Corrections: [/u]

- The victory/defeat screen no longer remains if the player returns to the Lobby while it is still displayed.
- The camera is now blocked by the red covers in the Makhassim Plaza.
- The death screen is correctly disabled when you come back to the lobby.
- Typo and translations corrections.
- The icons for the passives skills in the Spellbook are now displayed correctly.

[u]Balancing: [/u]

- Balanced the melee combo tree containing Biting and Suction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/ac423a397ea7237d2d890df00b2b64d0084cc65e.png[/img]

[u]New: [/u]

- New affixes, help messages and visual feedback for chapters 1, 2 and 3 of Dumuzid.
- New VFX to add readability to certain fights/spells.
- The "Ready" button can now be moved with the interface editor.
- An option to manage the quality of volumetric lights (Fog) has been added in the graphics options.
- The resolutions of 16/10 screens and wide screens are now compatible.
- New portraits for your characters are available.
- It is now possible to click on allies or enemies names to select them.
- New ambient sounds on Makkhassim Plaza and in the Nademasir.
- Disabled some buttons during the Prologue.
- Dyes and tags to craft can be previewed in the Crafting screen.
- Pressing "ESC" exits the interface editor.
- The interaction button is now clickable.
- Added a button to restore all presets in the Spellbook.
- Added an option to the main menu to redeem codes and get rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/6c88acea530f876f500fab2a9cdeac62bc701f8f.png[/img]

[u]Cellyon: Boss Maker: [/u]

- Stability fixes have been made to Cellyon: Boss Maker.
- The "Temple" of Humbaba is now available in Cellyon: Boss Maker.
- The Summon Node now has an option to define who the monsters  will attack when they have no more targets.
- The Move Node system has been completely revised by separating types of movement (teleportation, distance, ...) and types of destination.
- Musics of the different maps are disabled and only the music of the Editor is played in loop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/ed802ff307c0f0e2a3ea6b73c22cb5bd74a70a2a.png[/img]

[u]Steam Workshop: [/u]

In order to make it easier to share and access bosses created by the community, we have completely reworked the system for sharing and accessing custom bosses.
In addition, we enabled the Steam Workshop, so you can now more easily meet and discuss about your creations!

- The list of bosses for the editor and the custom games now makes the difference between official bosses from the game, bosses created by the player and bosses downloaded from the workshop. (In order to protect their secrets, you can't open the downloaded boss in the editor).
- The start up screen of the editor now displays all your bosses and offers workshop publication and deletion options.
- You can now start a custom game directly from the lobby or another boss.

We hope that you'll enjoy this update and if you have any suggestions or wishes regarding the game, let us know on the community hub or directly on Discord: https://discord.gg/ErnVfzM

notes.title: Update v0.9.6: Interface Editor & general fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Adventurers, [/h1]

Welcome to the patch 0.9.6, which includes a lot of optimization as well as the function that you all requested from us: the interface edition.

[u]Optimization:[/u]

- Improved performance of shadow display
- Improvement of the tab-targetting system
- Improved general performance
- Optimized interface images to significantly reduce memory usage

[u]Changes:[/u]

- Puzzle loot icon changed
- The animations for the melee spells Biting and Chewing and their VFXs have been revised and improved
- The name of a player in Trance (Rift mode) is now displayed above their head
- Rift mode: the team of the player is always displayed first
- The affix system has been revised
- The environment where the Dumuzid fights take place has been resized to better match the size of the characters
- The appearance and the size of the Withered Tantalion have been revised for a better readability during fights against EL-29 (Chapter 2 and 3)
- The prototypes in EL-29 Chapter 1 have new textures and names

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32300704/e8289e25fa350c1619272a1c1db0969a4c50c612.png[/img]

[u]Corrections:[/u]

- Male Hunter and Interceptor armors are now correct
- Fixed memory leaks resulting in game slowing down when a player chained many games
- Boss Maker: fixed several bugs
- The sequence of spells no longer causes an animation bug (visual only)
- The tantalion carrying the bomb in EL-29 chapter 2 now correctly drops its bomb when it arrives at its destination

[u]Add:[/u]

- New affixes, help messages and visual feedback for chapters 1, 2 and 3 of Skain
- New affixes, help messages and visual feedback for chapters 1 and 2 of EL-29
- A loading icon is displayed at launch
- A Trance animation (Rift mode) has been added
- Players can now edit their interface in-game
- The animations of the new spells: Lethal agitation / Charge / Double embrace / Explosive globules / Bloody grenade / Blood swamp / Agitated parasite and Salutary bonding have been integrated

[h1]Interface Editor[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /32300704/6faa1377ede9546d44ad36b202ca36350f57dc0c.png[/img]

The interface editor is accessible from the [i]ESC[/i] menu or directly using the keyboard shortcut [i]U[/i].

By selecting an interface element from the dropdown list or by clicking directly on the corresponding item, you can move it wherever you want. You can also:
[list]
[*] Show / Hide the element using the "Visible" option
[*] Resize the element with the "Scale" option
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.9.4 : Patch notes
notes.content:
[h1] [u]A new progression system:[/u] [/h1]

- Some spells are now blocked by default.
- There are now 4 difficulty levels: Easy / Normal / Hard and Mythic.
- You can unlock new spells by earning Talent levels the first time you beat a boss in a certain difficulty setting.
- A new mode is available : The Hunt. Each day, 3 boss are picked for you to challenge in a difficulty level from 1 to 5. Each difficulty adds 20% to the boss' health and damages, and adds random modifications to the fight. The challenge will be difficult but it's the best way to loot valuable goods. 
- The battle menu has been adapted to the new options.
- A new tab in the spell book : Bonus, allows you to increases the stats of your character in Hunt mode.

[u]Other new features: [/u]

- Ambient sounds have been added to the prologues.
- Sound effects have been added to the gas explosion and roof fall VFX.
- Sounds have been added for button hover and clicks.
- VFX have been added to spells that did not have them.
- Impact VFXs have been revised and new ones have been added.
- The customization panel allows you to choose between a masculine or a feminine character.
- Characters can now equip passive spells. A player can have up to 3 passive spells at the same time.

[u]Changes: [/u]

- Impact VFXs have been revised and new ones have been added.
- The models for the characters have been improved.
- Tooltips have been reworked to improve readability.
- Bots now have a personality (name + skin).
- Rewards are now displayed in the battle menu.

[u]Corrections: [/u]

- Some VFX have been revised to be more visible.
- Fixed some combat animations.
- The health bars have been improved for better readability.

[h1] [u]Preview, the Rift: [/u] [/h1]

Please feel free to comment on the changes on our Discord https://discord.gg/ErnVfzM

- Fixed a bug where the tooltip corresponding to a resource bar would not appear when hovering the resource icon.
- Fixed a bug where holding the two mouse clicks to make the character move forward wouldn't work.
- The Hemorrhage debuff icon is now only visible for the caster of the spell.
- Fixed a mistake in the tooltip of lethal gift of blood.

notes.title: Patch Notes v 0.1.5 : Tester of puppets
notes.content:
Main Menu :

    - Menu now displays all the available game modes
    - Custom game mode is accessible
    - Editor is accessible

Game :

    - Console is now opened by "²" key instead of ","
    - Collisions between players, enemies, and environment are way smoother

Custom games :

    - Players can now create and join custom games from the main menu
    - The host can choose a boss from in official list or the custom bosses from the editor
    - When every player is ready, the game starts automatically
    
Editor :

    - The editor is funtionnal but undocumented and not user-friendly, since it will undergo heavy rework for the next patch
